<description>
These two -netinfo counters are uint8_t while the others are uint16_t, so they wrap at 256 (reachable for manual peers via addnode onetry).
</description>

<commits>
feeb2fdccf cli: use uint16_t for -netinfo block-relay and manual peer counts

The other -netinfo peer counts are uint16_t, but these two were uint8_t
and wrap at 256. Manual peers aren't limited to the 8 -addnode slots
(addnode onetry connections also count as manual), so the manual count
can reach that and the "manual" column then disappears or shows a
wrapped value.
</commits>
